topic: Folding gift box RFQ buyer brief

buyer_wording_groups.wording: foldable gift box / foldable gift boxes
buyer_wording_groups.likely_intent: The buyer may need a flat-shipping gift box, a collapsible rigid box or a lighter folding carton.
buyer_wording_groups.route_note: Confirm whether foldable means a premium rigid-style structure or a standard folding carton before quoting.

buyer_wording_groups.likely_intent: The buyer is comparing bulk supplier options and may need consistent structure, insert and packing assumptions.
buyer_wording_groups.route_note: Compare suppliers using the same board, closure, finish, insert and packing route.

buyer_wording_groups.likely_intent: The buyer is looking for factory-side structure review rather than only a trading listing.
buyer_wording_groups.route_note: Prepare product dimensions, dieline status, artwork status and destination market before RFQ.

buyer_wording_groups.wording: custom rigid box packaging / luxury gift box supplier
buyer_wording_groups.likely_intent: The buyer is evaluating premium gift packaging and may compare rigid, drawer, magnetic or lid-and-base formats.
buyer_wording_groups.route_note: Review structure and insert together before selecting surface finish.

rfq_inputs: Gift-set layout or number of products inside the box
